metadata.title: Mobile Admin / Break-Glass Clarifier

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for explicitly restricting administrative and break-glass access models from mobile platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile platforms, device management controls, access revocation, and emergency access boundaries.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern asserting strict separation between mobile access and privileged or break-glass administrative operations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Admin / Break-Glass Clarifier aligns with least privilege and Zero Trust guidance forbidding implicit administrative trust.

metadata.remarks: This pattern explicitly declares that mobile platforms do not support administrative or break-glass access models. All privileged, emergency, or override access must be brokered through Secure Endpoint environments, typically DAWs.

components.title: No Mobile Administrative Context
components.description: Explicitly prohibits administrative or privileged execution contexts on mobile platforms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted accounts or contexts to gain administrative access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strict privilege boundaries prevent over-trust of mobile contexts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege is enforced by prohibiting administrative roles on mobile platforms.
Mobile access is restricted to non-privileged use cases.

components.title: No Mobile Break‑Glass Access
components.description: Explicitly forbids break‑glass, emergency override, or bypass mechanisms on mobile platforms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of emergency or bypass credentials outside intended circumstances.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Elimination of emergency override paths from mobile contexts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Emergency and privileged accounts are not accessible from mobile platforms.
Security architecture explicitly excludes mobile break-glass paths.

components.title: Administrative Access Redirection
components.description: Ensures any workflow requiring administrative or emergency access is redirected to Secure Endpoint environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through unintended execution context.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit workflow routing enforces correct execution environment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access enforcement ensures administrative actions require approved endpoints.
Re-authentication and stronger assurance are required for privileged access paths.
